import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { userRoles } from "../../../backend/schema/user_roles";

// A board over "role" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "role", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const userRolesCms = customizeTable<typeof userRoles>("user_roles", {
    icon: "Users",
    fieldOrder: ["id", "role", "user", "granter", "createdAt", "updatedAt"]
});
